title: Hammerhead
description: HAMMERHEAD (front) was envisioned by Artist Ron Cobb as a water creature who could also breathe air (or suck up a drink) through his bizarrely-shaped head. Although the Cantina scene was relatively short, its uniqueness made the creatures big hits, especially the ones turned into small toy action figures like Hammerhead. The exotic tropical forest creature (back), with langurous leaves for arms and feet, was a bit too complex to make three-dimensional.
